name: Annapurna Circuit Trek
sub_region: Lamjung, Manang and Mustang Districts, Gandaki Province (Annapurna Conservation Area)

difficulty.notes: Non-technical high-pass trek; crux is the Thorong La (5,416 m) crossing, a 7-9 hour day starting pre-dawn from Thorong Phedi or High Camp. Sleeping altitudes above 4,000 m for 2-3 nights. [s4][s5]

duration_days.basis: full trip Kathmandu-Kathmandu, jeep to Dharapani, flight Jomsom-Pokhara
duration_days.notes: Road construction has shortened the circuit: jeeps now reach Manang on the east side and Muktinath on the west, so the classic ~21-day walk-out via Tatopani/Ghorepani is optional. Variants: (1) full walking version via NATT trails, ending via Tatopani-Ghorepani-Poon Hill (~19-21 days) [s6][s9]; (2) Tilicho Lake (4,919 m) side trip from Manang via Khangsar, Shree Kharka (4,080 m) and Tilicho Base Camp (4,150 m), rejoining at Yak Kharka, adds 2-3 days [s7][s8]; (3) drive out from Muktinath/Jomsom to Pokhara instead of flying.

itinerary.notes: Kathmandu-Besisahar about 7-8 h (~185 km); jeep up the Marsyangdi road to Dharapani skips the road-affected lower section. [s5][s7]

itinerary.route: Upper Pisang - Ghyaru - Ngawal - Manang (high route)
itinerary.notes: NATT high route avoids the valley road; Manang listed 3,519-3,540 m by sources. [s5][s7][s9]
Optional hike to Ice Lake (Kicho Tal, ~4,600 m) or Gangapurna viewpoint; HRA clinic in Manang gives altitude talks. [s5][s7]
Some groups continue to Thorong High Camp (4,850-4,925 m) to shorten the pass day. [s4][s5]

itinerary.route: Thorong Phedi - Thorong La (5,416 m) - Muktinath
itinerary.notes: Pre-dawn start; ~900 m up, ~1,600 m down. Muktinath listed 3,760-3,800 m. [s4][s5][s7]
~20-25 min morning flight; afternoon winds stop operations. [s10][s11]

itinerary.route: Pokhara - Kathmandu (flight ~25 min or drive 6-7 h)

best_seasons.notes: Best months per operator guides Oct-Nov and Mar-Apr. [s5] Winter snow on Thorong La and monsoon landslides on the Marsyangdi/Kali Gandaki roads are general seasonal risks (UNVERIFIED as specific closure dates).

permits.name: Annapurna Conservation Area Permit (ACAP)
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per foreign national (SAARC NPR 1,000), tax included; single entry; 2.9% surcharge for online payment; double fee if bought at a checkpoint; children under 10 free

guide_requirements: Since 1 April 2023 (NTB revised TIMS provision effective 31 March 2023) foreign trekkers on the Annapurna Circuit must be accompanied by a licensed guide arranged through a government-registered trekking agency. [s3][s13] Field reports describe enforcement tightening at ACAP checkpoints by 2026. [s12]

flights: Jomsom - Pokhara, ~20-25 min, Twin Otter, early-morning only (Tara Air, Summit Air); regular scheduled service suspended in mid/late October 2026 with charters still running [s10][s11][s15]
drives: Besisahar - Dharapani/Chame by jeep on the Marsyangdi road [s7]
Muktinath/Jomsom - Pokhara via Beni by jeep, 7-9 h (Beni-Mustang road was blocked by floods in October 2026) [s15][s16]
logistics.notes: Teahouses throughout. Road now runs Besisahar to Manang and Beni to Muktinath; NATT side-trails (red-white and blue-white markers) avoid much of it. [s6][s9]

highlights: Crossing Thorong La (5,416 m), one of the highest trekking passes in Nepal [s4][s5]
Upper Pisang - Ghyaru - Ngawal high route with Annapurna II, III, IV and Gangapurna views [s5][s9]
Muktinath temple, sacred to Hindus and Buddhists [s5]
Optional Tilicho Lake (4,919 m) side trip [s7][s8]
Descent into the Kali Gandaki valley, Kagbeni and Jomsom [s4]
risks: Acute mountain sickness; the road lets travellers gain altitude too fast (Besisahar 760-820 m to Manang 3,520 m by vehicle) [s9]
Long, cold pre-dawn Thorong La day; snow can make the pass hazardous
Dust, traffic and noise on road sections; landslides on unengineered roads [s6][s17]
Tilicho variant: exposed, landslide-prone scree traverse between Shree Kharka and Tilicho Base Camp [s7][s8]
Jomsom flight delays/cancellations from wind and weather; Oct 2026 suspension of scheduled flights and flood-blocked Beni-Mustang road [s10][s15][s16]

acclimatization.notes: Standard is one rest day in Manang with a hike to ~4,600 m (Ice Lake); Tilicho variant adds extra nights above 4,000 m that help acclimatisation for the pass. [s5][s7]

unverified: Whether a TIMS card is still required/checked for the Annapurna Circuit in 2026: NTB lists it as required (agency-issued, NPR 2,000) but operator field reports say TIMS was dropped/not checked in the Annapurna region since 2023.
Exact seasonal closure timing of Thorong La from snow and monsoon road closures (general knowledge, not tied to an authoritative source).
Village altitudes vary slightly between sources (Manang 3,519-3,540 m; Muktinath 3,760-3,800 m; Yak Kharka 4,018-4,050 m; High Camp 4,850-4,925 m).
